text:
Sam: Heads-up — NovaRetail wants a tiny evidence pack to run a POC this week. Ask: SOC2 controls excerpt (storage + networking), a signed pen-test attestation, a presigned upload URL for their artifacts, and a clear note on Dedicated burst pricing. Can we split tasks?
Asha: I can extract storage/network controls + a short note about KMS/data residency. Do we need EU-only wording?
Sam: yes EU residency called out. Keep it redacted for customer PII and internal IPs.
Jules: Legal/pen-test: I need the vendor name and the exact scan scope + signatory. Ben — can you handle?
Ben: I can sign a standard attestation. Need vendor and contact, and whether the scope is just external app or includes staging infra. Also will add one-line limitation: "no keys/secret exposure".
Sam: vendor = DriftSec. Contact = claire@novaretail.com. Scope = external webapp + one staging subnet.
Maddy: I will issue a presign (default 24h). If they ask longer, we can reissue. Command I'll run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/novaretail/poc.zip --expires-in 86400`
Asha: I'll prepare an "evidence index" (one page) listing what we attach and what we won't. Helps speed legal review.
SalesOps: For Dedicated bursts: short bursts allowed but billed. Typical uplift we quote is 18-25% depending on GPU family and duration. I can run numbers if you give committed baseline and expected burst hours.
Sam: baseline is 8 GPUs reserved, expecting ~4h/day burst for 3 days. Can you produce an estimate?
SalesOps: will calc and post an itemised quote in the morning.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: when shipping SOC2 excerpts externally include a retention and redaction note. Do not include raw logs.
Ben: Drafted pen-test attestation uploaded to legal-share. I can sign once Asha confirms the excerpt doesn't leak any operational secrets.
Asha: excerpt in progress. I'll replace hostnames with placeholders and include an EU residency statement.
Maddy: Presign URL created: https://s3-presign.example/novaretail-ef12 (24h). If they need 48h, I can reissue after legal OK.
Sam: Sent bundle + short "what we share / what we don't" doc to Claire. She asked for 48h presign and confirmation we won't keep uploads beyond 14 days. Is that retention ok?
Ben: 48h ok for POC; retention 14 days is fine but include a line about scheduled deletion and contact for exceptions.
Jules: I'll countersign pen-test attestation and attach the signed PDF.
Sam: Great. Closing once Claire confirms upload started. I'll file the quote once SalesOps posts numbers. :thumbsup:
